patthana16.43:1.1: atītārammaṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na atītārammaṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana16.43:2.1: atītārammaṇaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāgatārammaṇo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. ajjhattattika hetuduke naajjhattattika nahetudukaṃ
